social.text: Objective vs Subjective POV 🎬 Objective: the camera watches from outside, like a neutral observer. Most wide, medium and close-up shots work this way. Subjective: the camera shows what a character sees, putting the audience in their shoes and tying us to their emotions. Tip: set the scene with an objective shot, then cut to the POV for impact. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # POVShot # FilmTechnique # VisualStorytelling
